title: Linguistics-Aware Non-Distortionary LLM Watermarking
abstract: arXiv:2606.00613v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Watermarking should identify language-model output without degrading quality or limiting verification to the model provider. Multilingual deployment makes this harder because morphology, segmentation, and script change where watermark evidence can be naturally embedded. We introduce LUNA, a linguistically adaptive watermark that combines model-free detection with single-token non-distortion under the standard random-key model. LUNA estimates normalized next-tag entropy from part-of-speech contexts in an external corpus and uses it to set the depth of a non-distortionary binary tournament sampler; the detector reconstructs the same schedule from text, a tokenizer, a tagger, and a secret key. We evaluate LUNA on six typologically diverse languages and two domains against eight primary baselines. translated_title: 语言学感知的无失真大语言模型水印
translated_abstract: 水印技术应当能够识别语言模型的输出，同时不降低生成质量，也不将验证权限局限于模型提供方。多语言部署使这一目标更加困难，因为形态、分词方式和文字系统的差异会改变水印证据能够自然嵌入的位置。我们提出了LUNA，一种语言学自适应的水印方法，它在标准随机密钥模型下将无需模型的检测与单token无失真相结合。LUNA从外部语料库的词性上下文中估计归一化的下一词性标签熵，并用它来设定无失真二进制锦标赛采样器的深度；检测器则利用文本、分词器、词性标注器和密钥重建相同的调度方案。我们在六种类型学上多样的语言和两个领域中，与八个主要基线方法进行对比评估。LUNA在12个设置中达到了0.9959的AUROC，并取得了最低的平均绝对中位数困惑度偏移0.045；其95%自助法置信区间……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: LUNA提出了一种语言学自适应的无失真LLM水印方法，通过从词性上下文估计归一化熵来动态调节无失真采样深度，实现无需模型的检测，在六种不同类型的语言上同时达到了极高的检测准确率（AUROC 0.9959）和最低的文本质量损失。
en_tdlr: LUNA is a linguistics-aware non-distortionary LLM watermarking method that adaptively sets the depth of a non-distortionary tournament sampler using normalized next-tag entropy from part-of-speech contexts, enabling model-free detection with near-perfect AUROC (0.9959) and minimal perplexity degradation across six typologically diverse languages.
